_comment: Curated list of apps. tools/refresh_apps.py reads this, asks the GitHub API for the newest release/APK of each repo, and writes apps.json. Live apps have a repo; planned items (status In progress / Idea / Held) have no links until something is published - add repo/web_url/apk_asset and set status to Live when they ship.

apps.name: JD's Toolkit
apps.description: A categorized directory of handy tools and websites (design, AI, free TV, money and jobs, and more), with search and monthly catalog updates.

apps.name: Vehicle Maintenance Tracker
apps.description: Track service history, expenses and reminders for tow trucks and other vehicles, with Excel export. Works offline; data stays on the device.

apps.name: Flimsy Read
apps.description: Private, offline-capable ebook reader and audiobook player with shelves, series sets, cover search and optional Google Drive reading-state sync.

apps.name: Folio Reader
apps.description: The original ebook reader and audiobook player (Flimsy Read is a renamed copy of it). Bookshelf, series sets, catalogs and deep appearance controls.

apps.name: Retro Pocket
apps.description: All-in-one Game Boy, GBC, GBA, NES, SNES and DS emulator that runs in the browser or as an APK. Bring your own ROMs.

apps.name: TVmate Touch
apps.description: Touch-friendly IPTV player: M3U/Xtream playlists, channel groups, EPG grid, HLS player with mini player and PiP. Android app plus an iPhone-friendly web app. Bring your own playlist.
apps.notes: Debug build. The APK lives in a private GitHub repo, so downloading it needs you to be signed in to GitHub.

apps.name: Android Optimizer
apps.description: Assess a device, monitor CPU/RAM live, close or freeze apps and apply safe, reversible tweaks. Standard edition needs no root; Rooted edition uses your own root manager.

apps.name: Image to DXF
apps.description: Turn pictures, scans, PDFs or camera shots into DXF cut files (closed outlines in real-world units) for CNC, laser and plasma cutters, with edit tools, layers, Fold/Box flat patterns and a 3D preview. Runs in the browser, with a Windows package.

apps.name: JD's Apps
apps.description: This hub: one place to open every live app and download every APK, refreshed every night at midnight (Pacific).

apps.name: JD's Towing - Long Haul Tracker
apps.description: Hours-of-service log for long tow runs: trip timer with over-limit countdown, jobs, expenses, weigh-station reminders, and export by job or date range. Checks for its own updates.

apps.name: Marco
apps.description: Self-hosted Marco Polo-style chat with push-to-talk and video messages for iPhone and Android, plus an admin panel.
apps.status_note: Working starter project (server, admin panel and Docker stack tested). The phone app has not been run on a device yet, and nothing is published.

apps.name: Tow Dispatch
apps.description: Self-hosted towing dispatch board with driver phone page and GPS sharing, live map, motor-club intake form and simple invoices.
apps.status_note: Working prototype that runs on your own computer or server. Not published yet.

apps.name: Tow Driver
apps.description: Native Android and iPhone driver app for Tow Dispatch: see assigned jobs, update status with one big button, call the customer and navigate.
apps.status_note: A local test APK exists but no release is published yet.

apps.name: JD's Towing & Roadside
apps.description: Portland towing and roadside-assistance website and PWA. Requests go out as a prefilled text message.
apps.status_note: Built locally (with a test APK) but not published yet.

apps.name: KodiHub
apps.description: Kodi (Android / Fire TV) add-on plus a web admin panel that combines live TV with EPG, your media library and scrapers.
apps.status_note: Add-on and admin panel zips are built locally. Not published yet.

apps.name: Solana Follow
apps.description: Windows desktop app to watch successful Solana traders and trade manually through Jupiter, with safety rails and a simulate-only default.
apps.status_note: Version 0.1.0 exists locally. Not published, and not financial advice.

apps.name: Solana Wallet Watch
apps.description: Self-hosted web dashboard showing near-real-time buys and sells of the Solana wallets you monitor, with risk badges per token. The server is watch-only; optional trades go through Phantom in your browser, simulate-only by default.
apps.status_note: Built locally, not published yet. Research only, not financial advice.

apps.name: Car Part Compatibility
apps.description: Phone app to check whether a part fits your car or truck (direct fit, needs modification or full fabrication), with step-by-step install guides, a garage of your vehicles, wish lists and parts listings.
apps.status_note: Early version 1 being built (Android first, iPhone-compatible); fitment data is still a small unverified sample set. Not published yet.

apps.name: Get Kraken
apps.description: A project chat exists. So far its work has been Solana Follow and Solana Wallet Watch (listed separately); no Kraken app files, repo or release yet.
apps.status_note: No Kraken app built or published yet.

apps.name: Media Server Setup Kit
apps.description: Step-by-step checklist and PowerShell scripts to turn a Windows desktop with 11 drives into an Emby media server, pooled with StableBit DrivePool and protected by SnapRAID parity, with firewall, power and scheduled-sync setup.

apps.name: Offline Survival Guide
apps.description: Single-page offline survival guide for the Portland area: water purification, first aid (people and dogs), food storage, heating, off-grid solar, sanitation, and Portland street maps, all viewable without internet.
apps.status_note: Repo created Oct 29 with the app as a zip file; not published as a web page or APK yet.

apps.name: SF Visits
apps.description: Field app for JD's Towing visits to State Farm agent offices around Portland: nearest-office check-in by GPS, visit notes and photos, follow-up reminders, referrals and route planning.
apps.status_note: v1.6 built as a test APK and web version on the box; not published to GitHub yet.

apps.name: Offgrid Kit
apps.description: Offline library and local AI helper for off-grid living: 44 practical guides (solar, alternator generators, batteries, water, first aid), Army field manuals, offline Wikipedia and maps, runnable from a PC or USB stick.
apps.status_note: Built on the box (Windows/Linux USB kit); not published yet.

apps.name: Home Server Dashboard
apps.description: Dashboard for the home server: status of services and machines in one place.
apps.status_note: Pinned until the server buildout is done.

apps.name: Local AI
apps.description: Run an AI assistant locally on the home server.
apps.status_note: Pinned until the server buildout is done.

apps.name: Media Library
apps.description: Home media library served from the home server.
apps.status_note: Pinned until the server buildout is done.

apps.name: Daily Briefing
apps.description: A short daily summary delivered each morning.
apps.status_note: Pinned until the server buildout is done.
